reason: I grab a cold Monster at the petrol station or Albert on the way, I don't plan my energy drinks a week ahead. Committing 649 CZK to a 12-pack of something with less caffeine than my usual can, before I've even tasted it, isn't how I buy.
objection: 80 mg is less than my Monster, so I doubt I'd feel it before the gym, and with no sweetener it might just taste like sour tea.
would_change_my_mind: Trying a free cold can at a launch event or a partner café and actually feeling the kick, or seeing it in the fridge at Albert or a petrol station.
